concept: Choosing to redo work that's technically 'good enough' because you know it could be better
source_inspiration: original content, informed by trade-mastery tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student completes a project that would pass as acceptable, but knows a specific way to make it genuinely better with more effort
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether to submit the 'good enough' version or invest more to improve it
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what made the difference matter, or not, in this case

assessment.success_marker: student can articulate a real reason for their choice, not just a reflexive 'always do more'
